hero: In a Cebu City government hospital ward, a Filipino nephrology fellow sits at the bedside of a 19-year-old Filipina nursing student with a faint facial rash and swollen legs, explaining a kidney biopsy plan with a simple drawing while her mother listens and a resident reviews results on a tablet; soft afternoon light, compassionate mood, no text.

figures.teaches: A nephritic urine with a rising creatinine triggers same-day serology, a call, a safety screen and a biopsy sorted by immunofluorescence.
figures.content: Top box 'Nephritic urine + creatinine rising over days (+/- hemoptysis, rash, sinusitis)'. Arrow to red box 'Today: ANCA (MPO, PR3), anti-GBM, C3, C4, ANA, anti-dsDNA; call the attending'. Parallel box 'Safety screen: TB, hepatitis B/C, HIV, pregnancy'. Next 'Biopsy when safe; do not delay treatment if ANCA or anti-GBM positive and deteriorating'. Three branches by immunofluorescence: 'Linear IgG -> anti-GBM disease: cyclophosphamide + glucocorticoids + plasma exchange (KDIGO 2021)'; 'Granular deposits -> immune complex: lupus, IgA, post-infectious'; 'Pauci-immune -> ANCA vasculitis: glucocorticoids + rituximab or cyclophosphamide (1B); avacopan may replace glucocorticoids; consider plasma exchange if creatinine >3.4 mg/dL, dialysis, rapid rise, or alveolar hemorrhage with hypoxemia'. Footer: 'Crescent: cellular (can resolve) -> fibrocellular -> fibrous (lost)'.

figures.teaches: The location of immune deposits determines the lupus nephritis class, its clinical picture and its treatment track.
figures.content: Six columns, each with a small glomerular capillary sketch marking deposit location: 'I-II Mesangial' (mild urine findings; treat SLE), 'III Focal proliferative <50% glomeruli' and 'IV Diffuse proliferative >=50%' (subendothelial deposits; nephritic, low C3/C4, high anti-dsDNA; KDIGO 2024: glucocorticoids + MPAA, low-dose IV cyclophosphamide, belimumab with either, or MPAA + calcineurin inhibitor, 1B), 'V Membranous' (subepithelial; nephrotic; supportive care +/- immunosuppression), 'VI Advanced sclerosing >=90% sclerosed' (prepare for kidney replacement). Bottom strip: 'Everyone: hydroxychloroquine (1C). Report NIH activity and chronicity indices (ISN/RPS 2018). Total immunosuppression >=36 months for proliferative disease (practice point). Complete response: UPCR <0.5 g/g with stable function'.

card: A young Filipina woman with lupus and her mother speaking with a doctor at a hospital bedside, no text.
